label: Postgres: Insert Row
description: Insert one row into a table from a JSON object of column values, and get the stored row back (defaults and generated ids filled in). Unreachable database or a refused row (constraint, duplicate key): catchable by `error`. Unknown table or column, or `values` not an object: always fails the run.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Wire a PostgresAccess, or a PostgresDatabase's access output.

outputs.name: row
outputs.description: The row as stored. If a rule or trigger discards the insert, the node fails instead of emitting nothing.
